newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINVEST UNIT WINS FIM 100 MLN ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: FINVEST UNIT WINS FIM 100 MLN ORDERS.

text.p: Engineering consultants Jaakko Poyry Oy, part of Finnish capacitor and consulting group Finvest Oy, won two forest industry engineering orders worth a total of more than 100 million markka, Finvest said on Monday.
"Jaakko Poyry has been appointed main engineering consultant for Norske Skog Golbey S.A's new paper machine project and Metsa-Botnia's pulp mill expansion project at Joutseno," it said.
Metsa-Botnia is owned by Metsa-Serla Oy and UPM-Kymmene Oy.

Jaakko Poyry would provide complete engineering services for a new newsprint machine to be built at Norske Skog's Golbey mill in France. The machine will have a production capacity of 325,000 tonnes per year, Finvest said.
It is scheduled for start-up in early 1999.

Jaakko Poyry had also been appointed main engineering consultant for Metsa-Botnia's Joutseno chemical pulp mill expansion, including a new evaporation plant, recovery boiler, turbine and white liquor preparation plant.
The expansion is scheduled to be completed by the end of 1998, Finvest said.
